title: Q-MAINWRITER-REFUSED: workflow data commits to main are refused, so watchdog ledgers (runway, credwatch) never land
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** smoke-live checks runway, credwatch and backup-drill fail every run
**Done check:** grep:scripts/land_data.py::MAINWRITER-FALLBACK-1
**Status:** open

Evidence (watchdog run 44782325039, workflow_dispatch on main, 2026-11-20 17:20 UTC): every probe step passed, then Record failed. tools/push_main.py got HTTP 409 {"error":"main moved or refused 422"} from the tick Worker four times (seed/worker/src/maincommit.js), then the direct push was rejected with GH013 (changes must go through a pull request; required status check checks).

So the org GitHub App route is not exempt from the main ruleset in practice and everything the watchdog measures is dropped: resilience, ultrastability, credwatch, runway, needs-you.

Fix by construction: when the Worker route and the direct push both fail, push a branch with the same files and open a pull request that the lane merges after checks; log the 422 response body in maincommit.js (today only the status is returned) so the cause (ruleset bypass list or a protected path) is visible.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:scripts/land_data.py::MAINWRITER-FALLBACK-1

Live check: python3 scripts/smoke_live.py shows PASS for runway and credwatch.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-20T18:56:44Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists
